title: Repair the CI fallout of the 2026-09-22 remediation merge
goal: Clear the gate failures the #338 merge exposed — the Linux-only frontend path-case build break, nine golangci-lint findings on newly added lines, and five SonarCloud smells blocking the main Release Gate — and add a local guard so a case-only import drift can no longer reach CI.
statusNote: 2026-09-23: ci.yml/quality.yml on PR #338 caught two real defects (Frontend Contract build, Go Lint new-code gate); the merge then turned the main Release Gate red on 5 SonarCloud issues. The frontend path-case repair and the nine lint findings shipped in #338 (474d1f65); the five SonarCloud smells ship in #339 (5544e4be) with a new SQL clause test. The new prebuild guard makes case-only import drift fail locally instead of only on Linux.
technicalDebtNote: Full Smoke Suite is flaky on main (business/generated/module-governance-real.spec.ts hit a 60s predicate timeout on commit 2b1cba31 at 21:37 while the same commit passed at 08:17) and waits, and the .golangci.yml input still carries keys golangci-lint v2 rejects (goconst.ignore-tests, issues.exclusions, output.sort-results) so test-file exclusions silently do not apply; both are untouched here.
